I'll start by reading the existing SVG builders and how tiers currently declare hero art, so the new `tierHero` scenes match the project's patterns.This is a bounded implementer chunk with an already-approved spec, so I’ll match the existing `svg.js` builder pattern and wire the six hero scenes into it.Next I’ll inspect `wrapSvg` and an existing builder so the new hero scenes follow the same SVG contract.I have the builder contract and the six tier hooks. Next I’ll add `tierHero` and rewire the fallbacks.I’ll review the new builder for ES5 safety, silhouette rules, and that every scene still composes cleanly.`HRL_SVG.tierHero` is in place, the six tiers now fall back to it, and the banners are illustrated scenes rather than teaching diagrams.

### 1. Options and viewBox

`opts: { tier, title, subtitle }`  
Default viewBox **1200×420** (20:7). Missing/unknown `tier` → `rookie`. No arguments → a valid Rookie banner with no type overlay.

### 2. The six compositions

| Tier | What I drew |
|---|---|
| **rookie** | Empty diamond at first light. Pale peach horizon, a resting sun, treeline on the right. Glove on home plate with a cream ball (red stitches). Nobody on the field. |
| **sandlot** | Chain-link backstop filling the right half; one batter silhouette in the box, rear three-quarter, bat held back. Brand-red pennant on the crossbar. |
| **diamond** | Viewed **from the outfield** looking in (so the three fielders are rear silhouettes, not faces). Ready-position 3B / SS / 1B on a wide dirt infield. Red foul-pole sleeve. |
| **select** | High-angle field as pure geometry: navy position dots, no people. Teaching-colour arcs for ball (`#dc2626`), base (`#facc15`), and backup (`#16a34a`). Cream baseball at the LF contact as the brand-red accent. |
| **elite** | Dugout rail in the foreground, small diamond beyond. Lineup card and red pencil on the rail; a helmet shell (no opening, no face) on the far right. |
| **promind** | Dusk grandstand, bleacher rows receding, tiny diamond in the bowl. Radar gun (red body) and notebook on a near seat. Stadium lights and a faint moon. |

Departures from the suggested subjects: diamond camera is outfield-in so figures stay rear-view; select uses dots instead of bodies because the brief asked for geometry; elite gained a helmet still-life; sandlot’s red accent is a pennant; promind gained lights and a moon.

### 3. Contrast behind the title

Title (`#f6f3ec`, 32px) and subtitle (`#f6f3ec`, 16px) sit in the left third. A rounded navy scrim (`#062448` at **0.88** opacity, `rx="16"`) is sized to the text block. Cream on that scrim stays well above 4.5:1 even over the warmest horizon gold. With neither string supplied, the scrim is omitted and the quiet left third is just sky/ground — no empty hole.

### 4. Curriculum rewire

All six `heroFallback` values now point at `{ svg: 'tierHero', opts: { tier: '<key>' } }`. All six `heroImage` paths are unchanged.

### 5. Other deviations

- `opts.desc` and wrapSvg’s existing `width` / `className` still work, matching the other builders.
- Elite helmet and promind lights/moon are extra still-life, not a subject change.
- Files touched: `svg.js`, `src/curriculum-data.js`, `styles.css` (one rule: `.hrl-svg-tierHero { border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }`). No shell was used.
